shields_note: DShields(10) posted outside the 60; nine named Reflections III shields plus a joke entry 'The One Ring (for kicks and giggles)', shown as posted.
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting(7): Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Prepared Defenses (dested Heading For The Medical Frigate), Squadron Assignments, The Way Of Things, Your Insight Serves You Well, An Unusual Amount Of Fear; AUOF counts toward the 60.
Posted 'Prepared Defenses' (a Dark interrupt) on this Light list dested Heading For The Medical Frigate, the Light starting interrupt (precedent GPN 5369).
Posted 'Lando, Screamin'' dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel (the strategy calls him 'R3 Lando', the Reflections III card); 'Chewie, PO'd' dested Chewie, Enraged.

Posted 'Qui-Gon with Lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber; 'Leia with Blaster' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han with Blaster' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Wedge Antilles, RSL' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Jungle' dested Dagobah: Jungle.
Posted 'Weapon Levitation' dested the Light Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace); the Cloud City card is Dark.
Shields: 'Do or Do Not' dested Do, Or Do Not; 'The One Ring (for kicks and giggles)' is a joke (no such card), shown as posted.

Author's update (drop all ships but the Falcon combo, more Yoda Stew, add It Could Be Worse, swap Squadron Assignments for Wise Advice, maybe Luke With Lightsaber for Son Of Skywalker) not applied; dested as posted.
player_note: Byline Ryan "frenchie6901" French; same name and the same "Rebel Strike Team founder" signature as Ryan "Shadow 13" French (DeckTech 21029, 21257, 21545, 21906, posted the same weeks), so credited to the existing [[Ryan French]] page.
